articles.title: Dianna Russini marks return to social media by taking advantage of NFL Trade Deadline with first post since Mike Vrabel scandal
articles.standfirst: Russini hadn't posted on her X account since April, and she's now promoting her new show.
articles.summary: Russini hadn't posted on her X account since April, and she's now promoting her new show.
articles.body:
In the aftermath of the Dianna Russini and Mike Vrabel scandal, it was clear that the New England Patriots head coach was somewhat in the clear; at least professionally. Russini is the one who suffered the most, as she was fired from The Athletic and her journalistic career was in jeopardy.

But over the past couple of weeks, rumors began circulating that Russini was working on a big comeback. That was confirmed this week, as " The Russini Report " has been announced. It's a new weekly show featuring Russini that will cover NFL topics. It's set to premier on Wednesday, November 12 on BetUS TV .

Now that she's back in the media fold, Russini is taking advantage of her reporting connections and the timely NFL Trade Deadline to resurrect her social media career . In her first post on X since April 2 , Russini dropped some " What I'm Hearing " insider knowledge.

Dianna Russini returns to X with first post since April 2

Russini reports that the Minnesota Vikings are calling around the league for available quarterbacks. They even tried to poach Mac Jones from the San Francisco 49ers , but they're asking for too much at the moment. She also echoed Adam Schefter 's report that Kirk Cousins is still Minnesota's top option.

She also made sure to promote her new show in a follow-up post. The premiere episode will feature special guests Bill Parcells , Damon Amendolara , and Spike Eskin .

Fans didn't exactly take too kindly to Russini's first X post in seven months. They won't let her live down the Vrabel scandal.

articles.title: “$12,000 in rent and now rats?”: Shilo Sanders slams life in New York following disgusting encounters in restaurants
articles.standfirst: Deion Sanders' son has discovered another drawback to his potential move to the Big Apple
articles.summary: Deion Sanders' son has discovered another drawback to his potential move to the Big Apple
articles.body:
S hilo Sanders is finding that life in New York might not be quite as appealing as he initially imagined.

The former Colorado Buffaloes safety has been enjoying his time in the city, but a series of unpleasant encounters has left him questioning whether he could actually make it his home.

His latest complaint has nothing to do with basketball, football or the city's famously expensive apartments.

Instead, Sanders says rats have become an increasingly uncomfortable part of his experience, including an encounter inside a restaurant that reportedly sent him rushing outside.

In an Instagram Reel posted on November 9, the son of Colorado head coach Deion Sanders explained why the situation was becoming difficult to tolerate.

“I love New York. I’ve had a great time out here, but every place I go into, it’s rats, bro,” Shilo said. “I can’t do this. I promise you, I’ve seen three rats out here since I’ve been here. I can’t live like that, bro.”

The video then captured another moment after Sanders apparently left a restaurant because he spotted a rat inside. Someone subsequently informed him that the animal had been caught, prompting a relieved response.

“Oh, you got it? Oh, all right, they got it, bro,” Shilo said. “I had to run out of here. I can’t do this, bro.”

His reaction was another indication that the city might not be winning him over, particularly after his earlier concerns about the cost of finding somewhere comfortable to live.

The $12,000 apartment problem is still hanging over his decision

Sanders had previously discussed the possibility of relocating to New York during a house-hunting conversation in Florida. He initially appeared enthusiastic about exploring the market, even suggesting that he would film the search.

“I’m actually going to go out there and do a house hunt video there ’cause I’m trying to look in New York. Should I move there?” he asked.

However, the reality of the city's property prices quickly became a concern. In an earlier video, Sanders questioned how much living space renters actually receive for the money they spend.

“My biggest thing about New York, bro, is the square footage for the price,” Shilo said. “I don’t know who normalized the real estate market in New York, but it’s outrageous, bro.”

He suggested that even a monthly budget of $12,000 might not secure the type of apartment he wanted. That figure is far above the city's typical rental prices, but it highlights the level of luxury Sanders appears to be considering.

The wider market offers little encouragement. Realtor.com's October 27 rental report found that New York City's median asking rent reached $3,785 in the third quarter of 2026, a 4.5% increase compared with the same period last year. Manhattan was considerably more expensive, with a median of $5,375, while Brooklyn reached $4,197.

Sanders has also explored properties in Florida, including expensive rentals in Miami and Fort Lauderdale.

One downtown Miami property reportedly caught his attention because of its river views, but its $14,000 monthly price was too much for him. His brother, Cleveland Browns quarterback Shedeur Sanders, even offered to help with a down payment on a house.

New York's rat problem, meanwhile, has become a familiar part of the city's reputation. There has been some progress: the Department of Sanitation reported that 311 rat-sighting complaints fell from 25,230 between December 2023 and November 2024 to 20,025 during the following 12 months, a 20.6% decrease. The city has attributed the improvement in part to requirements for buildings and businesses to store rubbish in sealed containers.

Still, Sanders ' personal experience appears to have made a strong impression.

“I was gonna go house hunting, all that stuff, but I don’t know, bro. This ain’t my type of place,” Shilo concluded in the reel.

For now, the former college football player has not ruled out spending more time in New York, but finding an apartment he likes may not be enough.

After the expensive property search and the restaurant encounters, Sanders has another question to answer: whether the lifestyle is worth the price.

articles.title: Miami Ohio gets one of the strangest penalties in college football after wild scoreboard stunt
articles.summary: Miami University of Ohio received an unusual unsportsmanlike conduct penalty during its November 10, 2026, college football game against Ohio University at Yager Stadium in Oxford, Ohio. Stadium video board operators displayed images of additional yellow goalposts behind the actual uprights while the visiting team's kicker prepared for a field goal.
articles.body:
Miami University of Ohio received an unusual unsportsmanlike conduct penalty during its November 10, 2026, college football game against Ohio University at Yager Stadium in Oxford, Ohio. Stadium video board operators displayed images of additional yellow goalposts behind the actual uprights while the visiting team's kicker prepared for a field goal.

With Ohio leading 17-7 late in the first half, kicker Brack Peacock attempted a 34-yard field goal. The ball struck the upright and missed, but officials penalized Miami for the distracting scoreboard display. The penalty moved Ohio closer to the end zone and awarded an automatic first down.

Instead of attempting another field goal, Ohio tried a fake kick. Holder Magnus Haines threw a pass toward Evan Herrman in the end zone, but it fell incomplete as the half expired. The unusual penalty therefore did not produce any additional points for Ohio.

Miami ultimately won 34-17 after scoring 27 unanswered points in the second half. NCAA rules prohibit video board operators from creating distractions that interfere with play, a restriction expanded following a similar incident involving Oklahoma State in 2020. The bizarre call quickly went viral across college football social media.

articles.title: Nine years after the death of a Playboy model, a legal battle puts Shawne Merriman back in the spotlight
articles.standfirst: Kimberly Fattorini's parents are seeking to preserve a $4 million settlement and submitted text messages from the night their daughter died to defend their position in court.
articles.summary: Kimberly Fattorini's parents are seeking to preserve a $4 million settlement and submitted text messages from the night their daughter died to defend their position in court.
articles.body:
The death of Kimberly Fattorini, a model linked to Playboy who died in 2017 at the age of 30, is once again at the center of a legal dispute in the United States.

Nine years after what happened, the case once again involves former NFL player Shawne Merriman , who was found liable along with three other people in a wrongful death lawsuit.

The new battle revolves around a $4 million compensation . Kimberly's parents want to prevent the judgment from being reduced and, to support their position, they submitted documents that include alleged text messages exchanged during the night of the young woman's death.

The messages from the night Kimberly Fattorini died

According to court documents obtained by TMZ, the family submitted conversations attributed to Elias Wehbe, a former nightclub promoter linked to the case. Among the messages mentioned is an invitation to Wehbe's house to use cocaine, colloquially identified as "blow".

The parents also contend that Wehbe was aware of a message in which Kimberly warned that a friend had put GHB in her drink. According to the filing, he later allegedly saw the young woman, in an intoxicated state, leave in an Uber with Merriman.

Kimberly died on July 21, 2017, after a night of partying in Los Angeles. The autopsy determined that she died from an accidental overdose and found alcohol, cocaine, and GHB in her system. This latter substance has a very narrow safety margin, so even a minimal variation in the dose can induce a coma or respiratory arrest. Her parents filed a wrongful death lawsuit in 2019 to seek accountability for the circumstances surrounding her death.

In 2025, a jury found Merriman, Wehbe, and two other people liable . Subsequently, a judge formalized a joint judgment of $4 million in favor of Kimberly's parents. Now, Wehbe is seeking to reduce that amount, while the family has presented new arguments to preserve the compensation.

Shawne Merriman denied any wrongdoing

During the process, Kimberly's parents maintained that their daughter may have been drugged and may also have suffered a sexual assault. However, these claims are part of the family's allegations and should not be confused with a criminal conviction. The death was officially classified as accidental, and no criminal charges were filed against Merriman .

The former San Diego Chargers player denied having engaged in any wrongdoing. His representative also rejected the allegations and maintained that the police investigation had found no irregularities attributable to Merriman. As the dispute over the 4 million dollars continues, the new documents once again put the messages and the circumstances of that 2017 night under scrutiny.

Currently, Shawne Merriman is retired from professional activity after ending his NFL career in 2013, following eight seasons in which he shined as a defensive star for the San Diego Chargers and had a brief final stint with the Buffalo Bills.

Far from the gridiron, the 42-year-old former linebacker remains connected to the sports world as a television analyst and entrepreneur, leading his own mixed martial arts promotion, Lights Out Xtreme Fighting, while also managing his personal clothing brand and projects on streaming platforms.

articles.title: “She has some of the best relationships in the business”: Why the NFL is backing Dianna Russini’s return after the Mike Vrabel scandal
articles.standfirst: Dianna Russini is back covering football with a new weekly show
articles.summary: Dianna Russini is back covering football with a new weekly show
articles.body:
Dianna Russini ’s return to NFL coverage is already attracting attention, not only because of the Mike Vrabel controversy that forced her departure from The Athletic, but also because of the support she appears to have maintained among people in professional football.

According to sources cited by TMZ, Russini has received considerable encouragement from the NFL community since launching her new project, The Russini Report.

Those familiar with the situation reportedly believe that her relationships across the sport remain strong, with players, coaches and other influential figures willing to work with her again.

One source told TMZ: “She has some of the best relationships in the business, and there’s real excitement about giving fans one more place to talk football and hear what’s happening around the league.”

That backing could prove important as the veteran reporter attempts to rebuild her professional standing after several months away from the spotlight.

Russini announced her new role with BetUS on November 9. The project includes a weekly live program and a regular column covering NFL developments, matchups and news from around the league.

Explaining her enthusiasm for returning, Russini said: “Football has always been my favorite sport to cover, and I’ve really missed being in the middle of the action, breaking stories and connecting fans to what’s happening across the league.”

Her new venture represents her first major media assignment since resigning from The Athletic in April.

The controversy that changed Russini’s career

Russini's departure followed the publication of photographs showing her with New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel at an Arizona resort. The images prompted widespread speculation about the nature of their relationship, with both individuals married to other people.

Russini and Vrabel denied allegations of an affair, and the photographs alone did not establish that a romantic relationship existed.

However, The Athletic subsequently conducted an internal investigation into Russini's work and her connection with the Patriots coach.

The findings, published in September, concluded that the relationship violated the outlet's editorial standards because it had not been disclosed appropriately. The investigation did not determine whether the relationship was romantic.

The fallout nevertheless became a major professional setback for Russini , who had previously established herself as a prominent NFL insider through her work at ESPN and The Athletic.

Her return also comes with questions about whether she will receive the same level of access to teams, players and coaches that helped make her reporting influential.

Although TMZ's sources describe a welcoming atmosphere within the league, the NFL has not publicly confirmed the extent of its institutional support or clarified her credential status for major events.

That distinction matters because personal relationships within football and formal access granted by the league are not necessarily the same thing.

A new platform, but questions remain

Russini's new show premiered on November 11, although its scheduled noon ET launch was delayed by technical problems. The program eventually became available after the BetUS website experienced difficulties, reportedly because of heavy traffic.

The first episode featured football discussion and guests including former NFL coach Bill Parcells . Russini did not directly address the Vrabel controversy during the broadcast, instead reflecting on the time she had spent away from her career and with her family.

Her partnership with BetUS also represents a different professional environment from her previous positions at major sports-media organizations.

The company is an offshore sportsbook, and its regulatory standing has attracted scrutiny in the United States.

For Russini , however, the immediate priority appears to be returning to the sport she has covered for more than a decade. The reported encouragement from people around the NFL could help her regain access and rebuild an audience.

Still, the real test will come through the quality of her reporting, the sources willing to speak with her and whether her new platform can establish credibility over time. Her comeback is underway, but the questions surrounding her departure have not entirely disappeared.

articles.title: What NFL teams have a bye in Week 10? Everyone who's out this week
articles.standfirst: Four teams will sit out the NFL's Week 10 schedule, giving their players a chance to recover while the rest of the league continues its push toward the postseason
articles.summary: Four teams will sit out the NFL's Week 10 schedule, giving their players a chance to recover while the rest of the league continues its push toward the postseason
articles.body:
The 2026 NFL regular season is moving into its second half, and Week 10 brings a scheduled break for four franchises.

The Chicago Bears , Denver Broncos , Philadelphia Eagles and Tampa Bay Buccaneers will not play this weekend, leaving 28 teams in action across the latest round of games.

The bye-week arrangement means supporters of those four teams will have to wait until the following weekend to see their clubs return to the field.

It also creates an opportunity for players to recover from the physical demands of the opening nine weeks, while coaching staffs can review performances and prepare for the remaining schedule.

According to the NFL's official 2026 bye-week calendar, all four teams are scheduled to have their break in Week 10, which runs from November 12 through November 16.

The four teams with a Week 10 bye are:

The break arrives at different points in the season for each franchise, with some enjoying a strong start and others needing time to regroup before the second half of the campaign.

How the bye week affects each team

The Denver Broncos enter their week off in particularly encouraging circumstances. They defeated the Carolina Panthers 26-21 in Week 9, taking their record to 7-2 and keeping themselves at the top of the AFC West. The victory also left Denver tied for the most wins in the NFL.

Quarterback Bo Nix has helped guide the team through a demanding opening stretch, and the break offers the Broncos an opportunity to recover before returning to the field.

Nix described the team's position as positive, saying: "We're in a really good spot, obviously where you want to be." Denver will hope to preserve that momentum when its schedule resumes.

The Chicago Bears also enter the bye with a 7-2 record. Their most recent outing was a 27-24 victory over the Buccaneers on November 8, a result that strengthened their position in the NFC.

The extra week should give Chicago's coaching staff time to assess what has worked during its impressive start and address any weaknesses before the next challenge.

Philadelphia, meanwhile, has a very different situation to consider. The Eagles are 2-7 after losing 19-11 to the New York Giants in Week 9. Their break provides some breathing room for a team that needs to find answers after a difficult opening to the season.

Tampa Bay is also looking for a reset. The Buccaneers fell 27-24 to Chicago in their latest game and enter the bye with a 3-6 record. The defeat extended their difficult run, making the additional preparation time potentially valuable as they attempt to improve their position.

What does Week 10 look like for the rest of the NFL?

Although four teams are absent, the Week 10 schedule still features plenty of important matchups.

Thursday Night Football opens the round with the Washington Commanders visiting the New York Giants on November 12. Sunday's schedule includes the international matchup between the New England Patriots and Detroit Lions in Munich, followed by games involving the Kansas City Chiefs, Atlanta Falcons, Houston Texans, Cleveland Browns, Minnesota Vikings and Green Bay Packers .

The remaining schedule also includes the Pittsburgh Steelers against the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday night, while the Los Angeles Chargers visit the Baltimore Ravens on Monday night.

For fantasy football managers, the four bye teams mean several players will be unavailable for Week 10 lineups.

Anyone relying on key Bears, Broncos, Eagles or Buccaneers players will need to make alternative arrangements, particularly if they have limited depth at running back, wide receiver or quarterback.

The NFL's bye weeks continue beyond this round. Six teams are scheduled to sit out Week 11, making that the busiest break of the season, while no teams have a bye in Week 12.

For now, Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay are the four franchises with a weekend off. Their next appearances will come after the scheduled pause, with the hope that the rest will help them finish the season strongly.

Thursday Night Football opens the round with the Washington Commanders visiting the New York Giants on November 12. Sunday's schedule includes the international matchup between the New England Patriots and Detroit Lions in Munich, followed by games involving the Kansas City Chiefs, Atlanta Falcons, Houston Texans, Cleveland Browns, Minnesota Vikings and Green Bay Packers .
The remaining schedule also includes the Pittsburgh Steelers against the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday night, while the Los Angeles Chargers visit the Baltimore Ravens on Monday night.
For fantasy football managers, the four bye teams mean several players will be unavailable for Week 10 lineups.
Anyone relying on key Bears, Broncos, Eagles or Buccaneers players will need to make alternative arrangements, particularly if they have limited depth at running back, wide receiver or quarterback.
The NFL's bye weeks continue beyond this round. Six teams are scheduled to sit out Week 11, making that the busiest break of the season, while no teams have a bye in Week 12.

For now, Chicago, Denver, Philadelphia and Tampa Bay are the four franchises with a weekend off. Their next appearances will come after the scheduled pause, with the hope that the rest will help them finish the season strongly.

articles.body:
The 2026 - 2027 NFL season reaches its Week 10 with the pecking order already clearly defined, but with several matchups that could shake up the playoff picture. While the 49ers and the Bills set the pace at the top of their conferences, the slate dishes out heavyweight matchups on both sides.

A heavyweight clash at the AT&T in Dallas , a divisional classic between the Jets and Bills, and the AFC North’s most visceral rivalry between Bengals and Steelers to close out Monday Night. What’s at stake is no small matter: seeding position, the divisional lead, and, for those at the bottom, the life support keeping their hopes alive.

NFL Week 10: Where to watch, venue and schedule for all games

These are the fourteen games of Week 10:

Washington Commanders vs New York Giants

Time: 8:15 p.m. Eastern Time (7:15 p.m. CET and 5:15 p.m. PT)

Where to watch: Amazon Prime Video

New England Patriots vs Detroit Lions

Time: 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time (8:30 a.m. CET and 6:30 a.m. PT)

Venue: FC Bayern Munich Stadium

Kansas City Chiefs vs Atlanta Falcons

Time: 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time (12:00 p.m. CET and 10:00 a.m. PT)

Venue: Mercedes-Benz Stadium

Houston Texans vs Cleveland Browns

Venue: Huntington Bank Field

Green Bay Packers vs Minnesota Vikings

Miami Dolphins vs Indianapolis Colts

Carolina Panthers vs New Orleans Saints

Buffalo Bills vs New York Jets

Jacksonville Jaguars vs. Tennessee Titans

Los Angeles Rams vs Arizona Cardinals

Time: 4:05 p.m. Eastern Time (3:05 p.m. CET and 1:05 p.m. PT)

Venue: State Farm Stadium

Seattle Seahawks vs Las Vegas Raiders

San Francisco 49ers vs Dallas Cowboys

Time: 4:25 p.m. Eastern Time (3:25 p.m. CET and 1:25 p.m. PT)

Pittsburgh Steelers vs Cincinnati Bengals

Time: 8:20 p.m. Eastern Time (7:20 p.m. CET and 5:20 p.m. PT)

Baltimore Ravens vs Los Angeles Chargers

The marquee matchup of Week 10: 49ers at Dallas

The marquee matchup of the week is played in Texas: the San Francisco 49ers, leaders of the NFC with a 7-1 record and a +79 point differential, visit a 4-5 Dallas Cowboys team fighting to stay in the wild-card conversation in the NFC East, where they sit second behind the Giants.

San Francisco arrives as the most solid team in the conference: its defense has allowed only 156 points in eight games, the lowest total in the entire NFC. Leading the offense is quarterback Brock Purdy, with a luxury arsenal around him: running back Christian McCaffrey, tight end George Kittle, and a receiving corps that includes Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel Sr., and Brandon Aiyuk. It is a roster built to punish mistakes and control the clock.

Dallas, meanwhile, lives off its offensive firepower: its 246 points scored are the most in the entire NFC, but the 236 points allowed explain its losing record. Dak Prescott has the tools to answer shot for shot — CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens form a fearsome receiving duo, with KaVontae Turpin as an explosive weapon and Jake Ferguson at tight end — but the Cowboys' defense will have to figure out how to stop McCaffrey's running game.

If the 49ers impose their pace, they can quiet AT&T Stadium; if Dallas turns the game into a shootout, things get tight.

Implications in the race for the top of the NFL

The slate has playoff implications everywhere. In the NFC, San Francisco (7-1) leads the conference just ahead of the Chicago Bears (7-2), so a win in Dallas would cement its advantage.

In the NFC North, the battle is fierce: Detroit and Minnesota share a 6-2 record, breathing down Chicago's neck, and the Green Bay (6-3) vs Minnesota game is a direct showdown that could reshuffle the entire division.

In the AFC, the Bills (7-1) lead the conference and look to strengthen their AFC East lead against a Jets team that sits at the bottom of the division. Behind them are Denver (7-2), Jacksonville, Pittsburgh, Kansas City, and Cincinnati, all with 6-2 records: Monday’s Pittsburgh vs Cincinnati game is, besides being pure divisional rivalry, a clash between two tied teams that do not want to give up ground in an extremely tight AFC North.

At the bottom of the table, the urgency is real. T he Los Angeles Chargers (0-8) are the only winless team in the entire league, with a -98 point differential that reveals a systemic problem; they host a Ravens team (4-5) that are not exactly arriving in top form either.

The Miami Dolphins (1-7) and the Tennessee Titans (1-7) share the second-to-last rung: Miami visits the Colts (2-7) in a matchup between desperate teams, while Tennessee hosts the Jaguars (6-2) in a clash with a very lopsided outlook. For either of these teams, each additional loss brings mathematically saying goodbye to January closer.

Prediction for the most important games of Week 10

In the marquee matchup, San Francisco's defensive solidity and control of the ground game should carry more weight than the home team's firepower: 49ers by the slimmest of margins in Dallas, in a game with points to spare.

On Monday Night, the 6-2 tie between Pittsburgh and Cincinnati promises a close finish, with a slight edge for the Bengals at home thanks to their offensive firepower. And in New York, the Bills start as clear favorites against a Jets team that has not found its footing.

Week 10 will not define the season, but it will say a lot about who is carrying momentum into the decisive stretch.
